thread:
Alex K: Quick idea — show a per-route card in the analytics console that combines: pinned model, routing policy, current quota burn rate, and a telemetry 'health' indicator. Sketch: tiny bar for tokens/sec + percent reserved capacity used + 'recent fallback' badge. Thoughts?
Maria T: Love it. Two quick constraints: sampling strategy (don't stream raw tokens into metrics) and cost estimate visibility. Suggest sample by route+model, 1% for low-volume routes, ramp to 10% for hot routes. Also a small cost estimate line under the badge.
Jordan (PM): Main concern — surfacing quota numbers might drive support tickets. Can we show an "estimated time to quota exhaustion" only for customers with comms enabled and behind a toggle? CTA should be clear: "Request Dedicated Capacity" or "Contact Sales".
Sam - Eng: From API side we can add a per-route telemetry rollup endpoint: `/v1/internal/route_metrics`. Need rollup windows (1m, 5m) and fields: route_id, model_id, qps, tokens_per_min, fallback_count. Prototype snippet: ```curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/v1/internal/route_metrics 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}' 
  -d '{"route_id":"r-123","model_id":"m-qlm-1","window_s":60}'```
Lina (design): I mocked two compact variants in Figma — small badges for latency / quality-drift / fallback. Tooltip on 'fallback' explains reason (quota/latency/maintenance). Link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/route-metrics-mini-card
infra-bot: release-bot deployed samp-config v0.9 to staging — sample_rate=0.02 for routes tagged "default".
Sam - Eng: Implementation note: avoid adding high-cardinality metric tags. Hash route_id to 64-bit and sample on request path before model selection so we don't duplicate counts for fallbacks. We'll aggregate at ingest with 1m/5m windows.
Maria T: Also want ability to pin metric thresholds from UI -> alerts. UX example: "Create alert when tokens/min > X for 5m" that links to a saved query + trigger.
Jordan (PM): Agree. Plan: Lina + Sam scope a canary for 5 customers next week, Alex I'll prep outreach.
Alex K: I'll open a tiny PR with API contract + console mock. @Sam - Eng can you drop a minimal server prototype? @Lina (design) please share figma id in thread. :rocket:
Sam - Eng: On it — will post a minimal server and a curl example to exercise `/v1/internal/route_metrics` when prototype is up.
Lina (design): Figma id: abc123 — added a compact variant for narrow panes and a full card with quota timeline + model variant history.
Alex K: Thanks all — copying this to #release-war-room once we have the proto and a short test plan. :thumbsup:
